title: What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine
abstract: arXiv:2610.37867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. translated_title: 什么是食物相似性？印度菜系中的视觉表示与检索
translated_abstract: 食物相似性是检索、推荐、替换及其他食物计算任务的基础，然而食物表示通常仅通过身份保持（identity preservation）来评估。我们探讨超越身份的食物相似性：不同的视觉表示如何将食物组织成关系邻域，这些邻域揭示或掩盖了哪些烹饪关系，以及这些结构在不同表示之间出现得有多一致。印度菜系提供了一个具有挑战性的场景：视觉上相似的食物可能具有不同的烹饪身份，而同一烹饪家族内的食物在外观上可能差异很大。我们使用扩展的Khana数据集和七个预训练视觉表示（涵盖卷积模型、基于Transformer的模型、自监督模型以及图像-文本对齐模型），评估图像到图像的检索和图像到菜品的邻域，考察烹饪家族结构、对比案例以及跨表示（的一致性）……
tldr: 该研究超越以身份保持为导向的传统评估，利用七种预训练视觉表示在印度菜系上系统分析食物相似性检索，揭示不同表示如何组织并揭示（或掩盖）烹饪家族层面的关系结构。
en_tdlr: Going beyond identity preservation, this study systematically analyzes food similarity retrieval in Indian cuisine using seven pretrained visual representations, revealing how different models organize culinary-family relational neighborhoods and what culinary relationships they expose or obscure.
